dz: 费姆雷特海战由伯克宾纳假人斯维尔·斯古德松取胜. 西古尔德松夺取了挪威王位,挪威国王马格努斯五世被杀死.
de: The naval Battle of Fimreite is won by the Birkebeiner pretender Sverre Sigurdsson. Sigurdsson takes the Norwegian throne and King Magnus V of Norway is killed.

dz: 埃尔福特厕所灾难:在Hoftag,亨利六世组织的同当地知名人士的一次会议上,大楼倒塌了,许多出席的贵族被淹在了下面的污水坑.
de: Erfurt latrine disaster: At a Hoftag, a meeting with local notables, organized by Henry VI, the building collapses and many of the nobles in attendance drown in the sewage pits below.
